remarks: Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in a convenient Darien location, this beautifully renovated and expanded Nantucket-style Cape offers timeless charm and exceptional functionality. Set on .46 landscaped acres, the light-filled home features an open-concept kitchen with updated appliances, gas fireplace, and spacious dining area flowing seamlessly into sun-filled living spaces and multiple stone patios designed for effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. Thoughtfully designed for today's lifestyle, the home includes two potential primary suites, flexible living and work spaces, a spacious walk-out lower level, oversized two-car garage, and beautifully landscaped yard. Ideally located close to schools, town, train, and beaches, this special property combines warmth, character, and modern convenience.
